content.thinking: py_compile created __pycache__ inside submission! That adds a directory/file entry, potentially violating? It's allowed as regular files/dirs under submission but unnecessary. Remove __pycache__ to keep tree clean. Also __pycache__ may contain .pyc referencing path; verifier collects it but not needed. Remove.

arguments.command: rm -rf /workspace/submission/__pycache__; find /workspace/submission -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -printf '%y %p %s\n'; find /workspace/submission -type l -print; find /workspace/submission -type f -links +1 -print
